acceptanceHistory.initialBlockingFinding: The first matrix fixture claimed to receive an Answer but only assigned fake signalingState=stable. It did not cover a revision 2 Answer arriving after the capability Bind advanced to revision 3, leaving a Low endpoint vulnerable to an unfinished old local offer.

mediaRevision: Terminal screen/voice history is excluded from the current active capability IDs
A same-context capability addition or removal may arrive before its local DTO while different known context IDs remain rejected
A Low endpoint requests a context negotiation restart when the context revision advances
A Low endpoint also requests restart when a capability Bind changes the active capability set
Restart cancels the prior negotiation bookkeeping, rolls an unstable PeerConnection back, and negotiates using the latest binding
A context restart requested during an in-flight offer is consumed from the offer's finally path
Signal processing retains exact media-context and context-revision checks
matrixFixture: The Low fixture now dispatches an actual revision 2 Answer after the revision 3 capability event and Bind
The Low fixture expects revision 2 and revision 3 Offers and zero rejected outgoing signals
chatScroll: A non-background initial message load waits for the message DOM, then scrolls to the latest message
An empty scroll container deletes rather than stores scrollTop=0 as an anchor
The fixture holds the message request, triggers a real empty-container scroll event, then releases the message DOM and expects the final scroll position at scrollHeight
Background refresh and older-history loading remain outside the forced-latest branch

independentStaticVerification.method: Read-only source assertions and control-flow review on the stable repaired snapshot

nonBlockingObservation: The stable code queues a lower-revision incoming signal behind the exact revision gate and discards it during a later flush; it does not literally drop it at receiveSignal as the handoff wording states. The queue is bounded and the repaired latest-revision negotiation does not process the old Answer, so this was not classified as a production blocker.
